no_adcom_quote.quote: The application for PLYNZIQ was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary; there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for BLA761079 (PALYNZIQ/pegvaliase). Section 9 of the Multi-Disciplinary Review states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues warranting AC discussion. A dissenting reviewer memo in the OtherR review argued the approval should have been vetted before an advisory committee given the immune-mediated antibody response and anaphylaxis risk, but no such meeting was held, so there are no AdComm-to-approval linkages.
